versions.effects: The target is @Condition[taunted|rounds:1]{Taunted} by you (1 round).

versions.effects: Your allies perceive the target one step better than they do: Hidden as Obscured, Obscured as Clear; Unsensed stays Unsensed (1 round).
Your next [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn ignores the Banes of far and maximum range, and counts each target's Cover as one level lower (Total Cover stays Total).
Against each creature you have Cover from, your Cover is one level higher, up to High (1 round).

system.flavor: You read the field the way others read a page: where a foe hides, where the gap in its cover is, where you yourself are hardest to hit.
system.automationNote: the Mode's pick; Call Out (enemies perceive target one step better, 1 round); Find the Gap (ignores far/max range Banes and lowers Cover 1 level, Total stays Total); Keep Low (raises your Cover 1 level up to High, 1 round).
